<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Update an API key"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/api-keys/{id}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Replaces the `name`, `permissions` and `expires_at` of an existing API key. All three
are written on every call: `name` and `permissions` are required, and omitting
`expires_at` removes the expiry. Regular users may only update their own keys and
only grant permissions they have (see `POST /api-keys`). Administrators may update
any key.
